ED Seizes Life Insurance Policies in ₹1,200 Crore SBI Fraud Case

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has seized life insurance policies worth ₹3.66 crore. This action is part of an ongoing investigation into a ₹1,200 crore fraud case involving the State Bank of India (SBI). The policies were reportedly from Zurich International Life Ltd. and were seized by the ED's Bhopal Zonal Office.
